page.layout: One column of running text, set in the centre of the page. Running head at the top above the text, page number at the top right. Catchword at the bottom right. No notes in the margins; the faint mirrored text in the right margin is show-through and is left out.

main_text.p: per verbum suum, per quod verbum postea etiam eundem redemit Mundum. Ergo idem finis manet in obseruatione diei Dominici, qui in sabbathi. Ibi praeter alios fines etiam fuit, vt recordarentur creati Mundi à Deo per verbum, & eorum quae post conditum illum contigerunt, vt quietis Domini,&c. Ita hic, vt scilicet recordemur, Mundum à Deo fuisse conditum, per Verbum, hoc est, Filium suum. Alteram, quòd hoc die Christus resurrexit à mortuis, atq; ita triumphauit de morte, inferno, Sathana: atque ita fides de nostra redemptione per Christum, obseruatione huius diei, in nobis excitetur & refricetur.

Ex iis igitur perspicuum est, Apostolos nihil in substantia huius praecepti mutasse: Deinde, quod mutarunt, illud etiam fuisse factum ex voluntate Dei: postremò, ex utilitate Ecclesiae, cuius aedificationi omnes debent seruire ceremoniae.
Ad secundam: Quòd verò sic inferunt, idem licere Ecclesiae.

Resp primùm. Cui Ecclesiae? Papisticae? nisi redeat ad obedientiam verbi, vt ei subiecta maneat: nihil habet auctoritatis. Non est enim vera Ecclesia, vt ex Augustino contra Epistolam Paphnutij, cap. 4. colligi poterit, quia discordat à capite Christo. page.notes: The lead mark before "Ad secundam" is a printed symbol I could not read with certainty; it is left out. The page number "159" is hard to read at the top right and is marked [?]. The running head was read as "SCRIPTVRA." and normalised to SCRIPTURA. Long s was written as plain s throughout. The lower-left edge of the page is shadowed, but no words are lost. Printed "Ecclesiae?Papisticae?" has no space after the first question mark, and this is kept as printed.
